name: Studio RCI
aesthetic_profile: Tactile geometry, earthy terracottas, walnut wood tones, and moody lighting choreography creating story-driven dining atmospheres.
signature_projects: Bomdia Restaurant (2,500 sq.ft. tactile geometry & ink blues), Bomdia Cafe (Matunga), Cray Craft, Trooh Restaurant & Bar, Atmosphere 6
address: Sai Bazaar Station Rd, opposite Santa Cruz Station, Santacruz West, Mumbai 400054
what_firm_does: Founded by Principal Designer Ruchika Chhabria, Studio RCI is an elite hospitality design practice known for atmospheric, story-driven restaurants, cafes, and bars across India. Featured in Architectural Digest and Elle Decor, their spaces masterfully balance functional F&B zoning with tactile materiality and bespoke illumination.
internship_details: Hands-on hospitality design training encompassing concept mood boarding, spatial layout choreography, custom bar & lighting detailing, and vendor/site coordination for boutique F&B destinations.

name: Studio Hasta
aesthetic_profile: 'Slow spaces' with textured lime plaster, rammed-earth textures, fragmented sandstone aggregate, Cycladic curves, and charred oak wood.
signature_projects: Sass Bar (Lower Parel), SAND Flagship Store (rammed-earth & monolithic stone), Su's Terrace Lounge (glasshouse lounge & fluted marble bar), Apartment 2102
address: G-1, Brij Bhumi Building, Nehru Road, Gujarati Society, Vile Parle East, Mumbai 400057
what_firm_does: Founded in 2019 by architect Nishil Shah ('Hasta' meaning hands), Studio Hasta champions slow, craft-centric, uncluttered environments that prioritize natural tactile surfaces over visual overstimulation. Their hospitality and experiential retail work is widely recognized in Design Anthology and Architectural Digest.
internship_details: Exceptional opportunity to learn tactile minimalism, raw material experiments (lime plaster, cast concrete, stone), detailing bespoke joinery, and crafting understated yet bold spatial experiences.
software_skills: AutoCAD, Rhino, SketchUp, Enscape, Adobe InDesign

name: kaviar:collaborative
aesthetic_profile: Monochromatic sculpted volumes, cave-like fluid curves, terracotta bricks, lime wash, raw gabion stone walls, and industrial steel accents.
signature_projects: Project Hum (Bandra farm-to-table, terracotta & lime plaster), Affogato (sculpted monochromatic coffee cave), Charlee (clandestine Bandra speakeasy bar wrapped in raw gabion & stone)
address: 101, C-Wing, Gurukrupa CHS, N.C. Kelkar Road, Dadar West, Mumbai 400028
what_firm_does: Co-founded by Kasturi Wagh and Vineet Hingorani, kaviar:collaborative has emerged as one of Mumbai's most innovative hospitality design studios. Rather than chasing fleeting Instagram trends, they construct deeply immersive spaces connecting the culinary ethos directly to spatial geometry and honest materials.
internship_details: Ideal for designers fascinated by monolithic sculpting, monochromatic material palettes, cave-like fluid geometries, and translating culinary philosophies into architectural storytelling.

name: Atelier Ashiesh Shah
aesthetic_profile: Japanese Wabi-Sabi meets Indian craftsmanship, cinematic room sequencing, lacquered Channapatna wood details, kinetic lighting, and raw textured plaster.
signature_projects: Neuma (Colaba heritage bungalow dining), Bar Paradox (Shakti Mills moody speakeasy with kinetic ceiling), Noon & Sequel (BKC organic dining & craft bead lights), Joshi House (Bandra haveli-inspired dining)
address: A 77, Kailash Nagar Housing Society, Forjett Hill, Tardeo, Mumbai 400007
what_firm_does: Led by AD100 architect Ashiesh Shah, this premier atelier is renowned across India for bridging Japanese Wabi-Sabi philosophy with traditional tribal craftsmanship. His hospitality venues are celebrated as theatrical, story-driven living spaces where every room reveals a distinct atmospheric chapter.
internship_details: Prestigious mentorship in luxury hospitality spatial sequencing, bespoke furniture and lighting prototyping, artisanal craft collaborations, and material curations for India's most talked-about dining venues.
software_skills: AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max / Rhino, Photoshop, InDesign

name: Tejal Mathur Design
aesthetic_profile: Distressed rustic luxury, crumbling-wall aesthetics, industrial vintage ironwork, raw reclaimed wood, arched glass windows, and warm amber ambient glow.
signature_projects: Pali Village Cafe & Pali Bhavan (Bandra vintage luxury staples), The Nutcracker (Kala Ghoda & BKC organic cafes), Donna Deli (white goth conservatory cafe), Adelina, Nava, Plural
address: 201, Vimal Residency, 10th Road, Khar West, Mumbai 400052
what_firm_does: Tejal Mathur is the legendary creative powerhouse behind Mumbai's most iconic, atmospheric dining institutions. Known as the 'purveyor of the past,' she crafts narrative-rich spaces with sister sourcing house Ironworks, blending nostalgic charm, reclaimed elements, and intimate emotional scales.
internship_details: Immersion in narrative hospitality interiors, custom vintage furniture fabrication with sister concern Ironworks, mood-driven lighting schemes, and antique architectural artefact curation.
software_skills: AutoCAD, SketchUp, Photoshop, Hand Sketching, MS Excel

name: MuseLAB
aesthetic_profile: Structured geometric grids and playful arches, raw teak joinery, whitewashed lime walls, custom lighting installations, and dual day-to-night spatial personalities.
signature_projects: Sequel (Bandra flagship organic cafe - quiet whitewashed lime & raw teak), Nho Saigon (BKC Vietnamese bistro and moody evening cocktail bar with teal detailing)
address: 101, Prabhadevi Industrial Estate, Veer Savarkar Marg, Prabhadevi, Mumbai 400025
what_firm_does: Co-founded by Huzefa Rangwala and Jasem Pirani in 2012, MuseLAB is a celebrated multi-disciplinary practice known for bespoke architectural storytelling. In hospitality, they excel at environments that transform seamlessly between bright daytime bistros and atmospheric evening cocktail lounges.
internship_details: Training in bespoke millwork detailing, dual-mode day-to-night lighting schemes, geometric space-planning, and high-precision physical joinery for boutique commercial venues.
software_skills: AutoCAD, SketchUp, Rhino, Enscape, Adobe Creative Suite

name: Saniya Kantawala Design (SKD)
aesthetic_profile: Textured monochromatic backdrops of jute and oak, sculptural ceiling art installations, regional craft heritage, and dynamic lighting transitions.
signature_projects: Oye Kake (subtle nude tones & ceiling installation of 40,000 traditional chooras), Mannrangi (earthy communal dining), Esora (winery bistro), The Bar Stock Exchange (Vashi)
address: Studio 18, 7th Floor, Tardeo AC Market Building, Tardeo, Mumbai 400034
what_firm_does: Led by Principal Designer Saniya Kantawala, SKD is an award-winning studio creating bold, experiential hospitality environments. Avoiding repetitive templates, SKD reimagines regional craft motifs into cutting-edge contemporary dining and nightlife frameworks.
internship_details: Exposure to large-scale ceiling art installations, tactile material sourcing, commercial F&B layouts, acoustics, and high-traffic hospitality space management.

name: Sameep Padora & Associates (sP+a)
aesthetic_profile: Parametric CNC-routed timber armatures, historic industrial masonry, undulating structural woodwork, cast-iron accents, and daylight skylight choreography.
signature_projects: The Clearing House (Ballard Estate - all-day sunlit Foyer and moody industrial Chamber dining), Indigo Deli (Palladium - iconic undulating timber ceiling armature), CRAFT Deli
address: Bungalow 22C, New Kantwadi Scheme, Off Perry Cross Road, Pali Village, Bandra West, Mumbai 400050
what_firm_does: One of India's most intellectually revered architectural practices, sP+a merges computational parametric modeling with localized craftsmanship. Their hospitality interventions stand out as structural marvels that challenge generic commercial mall and restaurant formats.
internship_details: World-class exposure to parametric digital fabrication, historic masonry conservation, structural timber assemblies, and complex spatial choreography for high-end dining.
software_skills: Rhino + Grasshopper, AutoCAD, SketchUp, V-Ray, Adobe Suite

name: Patch Design Studio
aesthetic_profile: Japanese minimalism meets audiophile acoustic architecture, curved wave bars, acoustic wood paneling, programmable ripple lighting, and brass details.
signature_projects: Nami (Bandra - 25-seater high-concept audiophile listening bar for ABNAH), Shizusan (mill-converted Asian shophouse), Eat Pray Luv (compact all-day eatery)
address: 1st Floor, Hari Niwas Building, 30th Road, Bandra West, Mumbai 400050
what_firm_does: Founded by CEPT and Columbia University alumni Ipsit Patel and Rika Chaudhry, Patch Design Studio is acclaimed for material-conscious, context-driven spaces. Their design of 'Nami' established a benchmark for high-concept listening bars in India.
internship_details: Specialized learning in acoustic spatial design, audiophile listening bar layouts, millwork fabrication, and Japanese-Nordic minimalist detailing for intimate hospitality venues.

name: Essajees Atelier
aesthetic_profile: Centuries-old exposed stone and brick masonry, triple-height timber trusses, daylight-pulling sky pipes, long island service counters, and raw architectural honesty.
signature_projects: Conçu (Colaba - 100-year-old print shop turned 2,700 sq.ft. patisserie-cafe and evening bar), Sobo20 (striking symmetry and artistic installations)
address: 1st Floor, Udyog Bhavan, Walchand Hirachand Marg, Ballard Pier, Mumbai 400001
what_firm_does: Led by Sarah Sham, Essajees Atelier brings multi-generational expertise in antiques and luxury craftsmanship into contemporary architecture. In hospitality, Sarah specializes in peeling back historical layers to reveal authentic raw bones of heritage structures.
internship_details: Mentorship in heritage adaptive reuse, structural peeling and exposure, natural daylight integration, and commercial kitchen/bar zoning within historic architecture.
software_skills: AutoCAD, SketchUp, V-Ray, Photoshop, MS Project

name: Sumessh Menon Associates
aesthetic_profile: Monochromatic sophistication, monumental glowing biophilic lighting sculptures, indoor trees, curved marble expanses, and textured acoustic soundscapes.
signature_projects: Juliette (Andheri - 4,000 sq.ft. European elegance with glowing floral mushroom lighting), Gong (soundwave architecture with curved marble & banana-paper lights), Zobet, Mirage Bar
address: 7th-8th Floor, Durga Chambers, Waterfield Road, Bandra West, Mumbai 400050
what_firm_does: Led by Sumessh Menon, this award-winning studio is one of India's leading authorities in high-energy luxury restaurants and experiential nightlife venues. Their work combines large-scale sculptural statements with ergonomic fine-dining precision.
internship_details: Experience in large-format hospitality spatial programming, monumental bespoke lighting sculptures, biophilic installations, and high-energy dining and bar acoustics.

name: Studio Pomegranate
aesthetic_profile: Chemically patinated steel interventions, industrial-chic microbrewery layouts, contextual material honesty, and Frank Lloyd Wright-inspired organic integrity.
signature_projects: Thirsty City 127 (Lower Parel craft brewery & cocktail bar with patinated steel), Ritu Kumar flagship stores, YouTube space Mumbai
address: A2-32, Shah & Nahar Industrial Estate, S.J. Road, Lower Parel, Mumbai 400013
what_firm_does: Established in 2013 by Shweta Shah and Pranav Naik (an alumnus of Taliesin, The Frank Lloyd Wright School of Architecture), Studio Pomegranate creates spaces defined by environmental appropriateness, deep craft, and metal patination experiments.
internship_details: Deep dive into metal patination, architectural honesty, custom industrial furniture detailing, microbrewery operational flows, and organic spatial design.
software_skills: AutoCAD, SketchUp, Rhino, Physical Model Making, Photoshop

name: SHROFFLEóN
aesthetic_profile: Memphis-inspired geometrical motifs, custom in-situ multi-aggregate terrazzo, playful color-blocking, and seamless indoor-outdoor alfresco connections.
signature_projects: Poco Loco Tapas Bar, Khar Gymkhana Poolside Cafe (bespoke terrazzo & fluid indoor-outdoor spatial boundaries)
address: 330, 3rd Floor, Kewal Industrial Estate, Senapati Bapat Marg, Lower Parel, Mumbai 400013
what_firm_does: Founded by Cornell University alumni Kayzad Shroff and Maria Isabel Jimenez Leon, SHROFFLEóN creates bold, geometrically disciplined spaces. Their hospitality and leisure designs stand out for bespoke terrazzo formulations and fluid transitions.
internship_details: Hands-on work with bespoke terrazzo pattern development, crisp geometric spatial layouts, outdoor-indoor F&B zoning, and clean minimalist detailing.
software_skills: Rhino, AutoCAD, SketchUp, V-Ray, Adobe InDesign

name: Architecture BRIO
aesthetic_profile: Compressed rammed-earth walls, slatted timber frameworks, serene water courtyards, open-to-sky pavilions, and eco-resort dining integrated into nature.
signature_projects: Tala Treehouse Resort & Villas (suspended slatted wood luxury in forest canopy), Mandwa Coastal Wellness Resort (compressed earth walls & ocean courtyards)
address: Studio Brio, Excel Garments, Dr. Veer Nariman Marg, Worli, Mumbai 400025
what_firm_does: Co-founded by Shefali Balwani and Robert Verrijt (with offices in Mumbai and Rotterdam), Architecture BRIO is globally renowned for sustainable resort and hospitality architecture that integrates seamlessly into natural landscapes.
internship_details: Unrivaled experience in sustainable hospitality masterplanning, rammed-earth and timber construction, blurring indoor-outdoor boundaries, and landscape-led dining pavilions.

name: Case Design
aesthetic_profile: 'The act of making'—uncluttered tactile minimalism, handcrafted teak and brass objects (Case Goods), stone masonry, and quiet contemplation.
signature_projects: Avasara Academy campus, Four Seasons luxury Mumbai residential and hospitality interiors, Case Goods furniture line
address: A-63, 2nd Floor, Nand Jyot Industrial Estate, Andheri Kurla Road, Sakinaka, Mumbai 400072
what_firm_does: Founded by Samuel Barclay (a former collaborator with Bijoy Jain at Studio Mumbai), Case Design is an AD100 studio rooted in traditional Indian craftsmanship and contemporary minimalism. Their spaces exhibit remarkable tactile warmth and poetic restraint.
internship_details: Collaborative work alongside master craftspeople, woodworkers, and stone carvers; prototyping furniture and lighting; crafting poetic, slow-paced interior details for discerning hospitality clients.
software_skills: AutoCAD, Rhino, Physical Wood/Clay Prototyping, Hand Sketching, InDesign

name: Studio Tessera
aesthetic_profile: Tessellated canopies, environmental simplicity, upcycled construction materials (rockpaperscissors lab), and contextual hotel pavilions.
signature_projects: The Glass House (contemporary tessellated polycarbonate & wood hotel pavilion in historic courtyard), Liquidply sustainable furniture collection
address: Ranwar Village / Chimbai Road, Bandra West, Mumbai 400050
what_firm_does: Founded by MIT alumna Sagarika Suri, Studio Tessera combines architecture with material innovation via their internal workshop rockpaperscissors. Their hospitality interventions turn structural constraints into tessellated light-filled pavilions.
internship_details: Experimentation with construction waste and sustainable materials, physical prototyping of furniture and acoustic partitions, and designing contextual boutique hospitality structures.
software_skills: AutoCAD, Rhino, SketchUp, Adobe Illustrator, Physical Fabrication

name: Studio Emergence
aesthetic_profile: Algorithmic 3D curves, undulating parametric wall treatments, dynamic lighting simulations, and futuristic fluid morphology for dining spaces.
signature_projects: Parametric hospitality sales lounges, undulating dining booths, kinetic commercial reception pods
address: 101, Upasni Krupa Building, Malviya Road, Vile Parle East, Mumbai 400057
what_firm_does: Founded by Seeja Sudhakaran and Khushbu Davda, Studio Emergence bridges digital architecture with experiential interiors. In hospitality, they deploy parametric computation to create fluid, Instagrammable spatial forms.
internship_details: Mastering algorithmic 3D geometry in Grasshopper/Rhino, computational paneling, parametric fabrication drawings, and digital lighting simulation for futuristic F&B spaces.
software_skills: Rhino + Grasshopper, AutoCAD, SketchUp, Enscape, 3ds Max

name: Baldiwala Edge
aesthetic_profile: Stark minimalism balanced by artistic flair, tactile terrazzo, brushed brass accents, and tailored psychological 'inner landscapes' for dining venues.
signature_projects: Quirk Box (Memphis-inspired bespoke apartment), boutique commercial galleries and high-concept cafes in South Mumbai
address: 21, Suleman Chambers, 4 Battery St., Apollo Bunder, Colaba, Mumbai 400001
what_firm_does: Headed by Ali Baldiwala in Colaba, Baldiwala Edge brings a 40-year legacy with a bold contemporary edge. Their hospitality and commercial spaces focus on sensory craftsmanship and bespoke material storytelling.
internship_details: Learning bespoke mood-board formulation, custom furniture crafting, tactile material pairings (terrazzo, brushed brass, raw timber), and high-end client presentation workflows.

name: Shiraz Jamali Architects
aesthetic_profile: Soft rounded silhouettes, organic curved partitions, raw earthy textures, custom metal shelving, and warm ambient illumination.
signature_projects: Publicis India fluid commercial offices, bespoke Bandra cafes, and high-concept residential dining pavilions
address: Bungalow 67, Chapel Road, Bandra West, Mumbai 400050
what_firm_does: Based in Chapel Road, Bandra, Shiraz Jamali Architects specializes in spaces that prioritize breathability, soft curved volumes, and material honesty, creating tranquil and memorable dining and commercial experiences.
internship_details: Experience in curved partition detailing, custom metal and timber joinery, spatial zoning for commercial and cafe projects, and site implementation in Mumbai's historic precincts.
